While witnessing cleaning of the cleanroom, two live insects were observed inside the anteroom beyond the line of demarcation. At the time, the Sterile Compounding Technician was cleaning the anteroom in preparation for the day's activities. The Technician noticed the first insect and shifted her body to step on it while wearing full gowning garb. She also continued to mop. Shortly thereafter, and prior to completion of mopping, a live spider was observed crawling from the same corner near the negative pressure room.
